title: Take the reward v2 discriminator width from the merged AMP feature contract
summary: With the AMP demonstration pipeline merged, locomotion.amp_discriminator takes its 61-value input width from locomotion.amp.feature_contract() instead of its own constant, so the AMP feature layout has one owner. The reward v2 branch merges main and records a fresh manifest.
next: Rebuild the paired reward v2 run packs from the merged commit, with termination rate in the protocol, for the reviewer's approval.
reason: The width is unchanged at 61 and the discriminator is an offline diagnostic, so no measured result, roadmap marker or gate changes.
